corrections.decision: TCR/FLSHCR/RBSR/SPNDST/DLPR are declared but have no access semantics in this driver; expose raw read-only views without guessing writes.
LUT array covers the two C-used sequences (0 and 1), four words per sequence; total hardware LUT sequence count is unspecified. RBDR has 128-byte buffer / four-byte words.
RCPU PWM uses ten 0x100-spaced channels starting at C0888100, not the AP 0x400 stride; C supplies only three registers.
IRQENABLE_SET_* are read/write enables in actual C RMW and disable paths; do not infer W1S from SET spelling. MSI bit11 overlaps EDMA_INT11, so expose the unambiguous EDMA range only.

Operational block address is capability base + read CAPLENGTH, not a guessed constant. C struct arrays describe eight port slots and sixteen endpoint slots; implemented counts are runtime capability facts.
Host-only/unused struct members have raw read-only views where this device driver lacks write semantics; port W1C/configuration is explicit-write only.
ID selection array uses only C-written IDs 1..3 in each port. ID4 is allocated but skipped before enable, so unknown slots are not invented.
Eight declared performance counters retained; Linux allocates only seven. Declared unused DDR registers remain conservative raw read-only views without reset/access inventions.
